name: Malaysian Resources Corporation Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成收购 Bukit Jalil Sentral Property 80% 股权，并拟以 RM419,051,556 出售 Cyberjaya 七块土地；同时宣派每股 1 sen 的首次及末期股息。
overview_en: During the year, the company completed the acquisition of an 80% equity interest in Bukit Jalil Sentral Property and proposed to dispose of seven parcels of land in Cyberjaya for RM419,051,556; it also declared a first and final single-tier dividend of 1 sen per share.

segments.name: 房地产发展与投资
segments.note: 今年完成收购 Bukit Jalil Sentral Property 80% 股权，并拟出售 Cyberjaya 七块土地。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of an 80% equity interest in Bukit Jalil Sentral Property and proposed the disposal of seven parcels of land in Cyberjaya.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以 RM419,051,556 现金出售位于 Cyberjaya, Selangor 的七块土地，总面积约 36.66 英亩。
actions.text_en: Proposed to dispose of seven parcels of land in Cyberjaya, Selangor measuring approximately 36.66 acres in total for a cash consideration of RM419,051,556.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以现金 RM1,420,906,521 支付收购 Bukit Jalil Sentral Property Sdn Bhd 80% 股权的余额，并代其结清 RM69,214,977 股东垫款，收购于 2026 年 4 月 20 日完成。
actions.text_en: Paid the balance of the purchase consideration of RM1,420,906,521 in cash for the acquisition of an 80% equity interest in Bukit Jalil Sentral Property Sdn Bhd and settled shareholder advances of RM69,214,977 on its behalf;

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 宣派每股 1 sen 的首次及末期单层股息。
segments.note_en: Declared a first and final single-tier dividend of 1 sen per ordinary share.

actions.title: MRCB - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派每股 1 sen 的首次及末期单层股息，除息日为 2026 年 5 月 4 日，派发日为 2026 年 5 月 20 日。
actions.text_en: Declared a first and final single-tier dividend of 1 sen per ordinary share, with ex-dividend date on 4 May 2026 and payment date on 20 May 2026.
